lens_summary.drift: REC-C2.0 turns the legacy EventBus surface into a measured, monotonically shrinking inventory (37 production occurrences) and arms a four-rule ratchet in the architecture gate. No runtime behavior changes. Six characterizations measure today's reality and surface two real defects (retained_until_session_end destroys evidence; fire_count never increments) that become REC-C2.1 DoD items. A pre-existing red architecture gate (TRUTH-001/002/003 missing the policy-required uat field) was repaired in-cycle.

findings.title: observe(retention=retained_until_session_end) destroys the evidence it claims to retain
evidence: chronos-services/src/observe.rs:279 calls TripwiresService::list unconditionally, which calls manager.drain_fired() (chronos-services/src/tripwires.rs:58).
Test: observe::tests::char_c2_03_retained_until_session_end_loses_the_evidence — the retained read returns 0 and the following drained read also returns 0.
Owner: REC-C2.1. Fix: retain for real (consumer cursor over immutable evidence) or reject as Unsupported.

findings.title: Tripwire.fire_count is a parallel counter that is never incremented
evidence: chronos-domain/src/tripwire.rs:119 initializes fire_count: 0; Tripwire::fire/fire_semantic take &self and return TripwireFired without touching it.
TripwireManager::evaluate/evaluate_semantic call record_fired (buffer append) and never write back to the Tripwire.
Owner: REC-C2.1. Fix: derive the count from persisted TripwireFired evidence.

findings.title: Architecture gate was RED on main: TRUTH-001/002/003 verified without the required uat field
evidence: Pre-existing on main@063cbdf8 (verified by stash + re-run): scripts/check_architecture_contracts.py reported 'verified contract missing uat' for TRUTH-001/002/003.
Repaired in-cycle (minimum patch, AGENTS.md §4 default): the uat arrays were added; the UATs already existed and were named in each contract's notes.
